6495-7084-8338.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
6495-7084-8338.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1329-3363-6798.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3363-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing The One Ring, causing you to surveil 1
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

645-1267-4247-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-4247-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

2292-2738-4871-6248.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

330-331-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander.
330-331-7839.description:
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Furnace of Rath.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

749-2092-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Lena from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Lena, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Lena by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2281-5237-5686.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2281-5237-5686.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1526-1978-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
1526-1978-3263.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat

1315-3293-5721-6763.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
1315-3293-5721-6763.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
1315-3293-5721-6763.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

225-539-1993-5621.notablePrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
225-539-1993-5621.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

2060-2744-3327-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2744-3327-6798.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4331-5139-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
4331-5139-6747.description:
Cast Relic of Sauron by paying {0} due to Sami.
Activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Relic of Sauron from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

719-1399-1606-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
719-1399-1606-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

542-4009.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using one colored mana.
542-4009.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using one colored mana from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Mox Opal from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

225-1170-2499-3389-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-2499-3389-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

586-1594-2438-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4186-5783-5785.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that has flying due to Combine Chrysalis.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 3.

1358-1912-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1358-1912-4131.description:
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, making Basalt Monolith a 3/3 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1732-2971-3662-3904-4377.notablePrerequisites: Initiate's Companion does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1732-2971-3662-3904-4377.description:
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Late to Dinner from your graveyard.
Declare Initiate's Companion as an attacker.
Finest Hour's exalted and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first Finest Hour trigger, giving Initiate's Companion +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second Finest Hour trigger, untapping Initiate's Companion and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Initiate's Companion.
Initiate's Companion triggers, untapping Izzet Chemister.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
Move to your second combat phase, and declare Initiate's Companion as an attacker.
Finest Hour's exalted ability triggers, giving Initiate's Companion +1/+1 until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Initiate's Companion.
Initiate's Companion triggers, untapping Izzet Chemister.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Late to Dinner and Walk the Aeons from exile without paying their mana costs.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Late to Dinner, returning Izzet Chemister from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Food token.
Repeat each turn.

575-1207-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander, adding one mana of any color.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Repeat.

224-4300-5196.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce at least {1}.

224-4300-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

3504-4112.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying {4}{U}.
Mercurial Pretender enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mercurial Pretender triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

1335-2066-2757.notablePrerequisites: Fertile Ground attached to a basic land.
1335-2066-2757.description:
Activate the enchanted land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Fertile Ground triggers, adding an additional {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature, untapping the enchanted land.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Repeat until Marath has no more +1/+1 counters.
Marath dies due to having 0 toughness and goes to the command zone.
Cast Marath by paying {R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, leaving zero mana unspent.
Marath enters the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the amount of mana spent.
Repeat any number of times.
